en: Dependent on a state without applied thought and sustained thought, a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state without applied thought and sustained thought, a state with applied thought but without sustained thought arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state without applied thought and sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of root condition … seven.
Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought arises by way of root condition ... seven.

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of root condition ... seven. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are forty-nine;
under object condition, thirty; under predominance condition, twenty-nine ... pe ... under prenascence and repetition conditions, twenty-nine ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, forty-nine.
